pass_1.locations: Original author-hosted Science supplement lines 112–147; scraper modified-oligo hits at 122, 135–140 inspected against source
pass_1.finding: PRO-cap omits PRO-seq RNA fragmentation, ligates standard Illumina 3-prime RNA adapter first, enriches biotin RNA again, applies Antarctic phosphatase before TAP, then ligates standard 5-prime RNA adapter, performs third enrichment, RT and PCR. Printed reverse PRO-seq adapters are expressly for another branch and must not be copied to PRO-cap. It names but does not print the original PRO-cap standard adapter bases.

pass_2.locations: Original author-hosted Science supplement extracted lines 105–148, especially run-on 105–111, first pull 112–120, 3-prime ligation 121–124, second pull 129–130, AP/TAP 130–134, 5-prime ligation/third pull 135–142, RT/PCR 143–148; scraper modified-oligo hits verified
pass_2.finding: Original PRO-cap uses four biotin-NTPs together, omits PRO-seq fragmentation, and has three streptavidin enrichments: after run-on, after 3-prime adapter ligation, and after 5-prime adapter ligation. Antarctic phosphatase precedes TAP; PNK is expressly omitted for PRO-cap. Standard Illumina 3-prime/5-prime adapters and RT/PCR primers are named but not sequenced; adjacent reverse PRO-seq oligos are for a separate branch. Current graph has all three pulls and the correct order. Exact original ligating-end geometry remains unresolved.
